definitions.gloss: anniversary of a death, memorial anniversary
definitions.explanation: A counter-like suffix used with numbers to mark the anniversary of a person's death, for Buddhist memorial services. The first anniversary is called {一周忌|いっしゅうき}; from then on the count includes the year of death, so {三回忌|さんかいき} falls two years after death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We will hold the memorial service for the sixth anniversary of my grandmother's death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Next month there is a memorial service for the second anniversary of my father's death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}→十三回忌：28964_juusankaiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた。
examples.english: More and more families are stopping memorial services after the twelfth anniversary.

notes:
COUNTING PATTERNS:
The counting of {回忌|かいき} follows a traditional system that is offset by one year from the actual elapsed time:
- ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧: 1 year after death (the year of death itself counts as ⟦{一回忌|いっかいき}→一回忌：30889_ikkaiki⟧, so there is no {二回忌|にかいき})
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧: 2 years after death
- ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧: 6 years after death
- ⟦{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}→十三回忌：28964_juusankaiki⟧: 12 years after death

This offset occurs because the year of death itself counts as the first year. ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧ is also read しちかいき.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: memorial service on the second anniversary of a death
- {回忌|かいき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: memorial service
- {回忌|かいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach a death anniversary

CULTURAL NOTE:
Memorial services (⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧) are held at specific intervals after death in Japanese Buddhist tradition. The major observances are the ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧ (first anniversary) and the 3rd, 7th, 13th, 17th, 23rd, 27th, 33rd and 50th 回忌, which fall 2, 6, 12, 16, 22, 26, 32 and 49 years after the death.
